notes: This is the v1 SEED for the declarative model registry (OT-P0-006).
Every operation has a commercial-clean, CPU-capable DEFAULT plus one higher-quality tier.

Policy (DECISIONS.md): stay gate-free (no Stability $1M-gated SD3.5/Turbo); GFPGAN excluded (RestoreFormer++ only); optional Python sidecar allowed for quality tiers; defaults + one quality tier per op.
Sizes and VRAM are APPROXIMATE (size_mb_approx, min_vram_gb) from public sources; verify at ingest.
Checksums are intentionally EMPTY: they are captured + pinned on first download (see checksum_policy). Do NOT hand-fabricate hashes.
Library-backed ops (Tesseract, goimagehash, gozxing, OpenCV) have no downloadable weights; checksum.status = 'n/a-library'.
checksum_policy: On first download of a model artifact, compute sha256, store it as source.checksum.value, and flip source.checksum.status to 'pinned'. Subsequent downloads must match the pinned hash or fail. Until then status is 'unverified-capture-on-download'.

field_reference.operations: ops this entry can serve (vocabulary in operations_vocabulary)
field_reference.default_for: ops for which this entry is the seeded default (subset of operations)
field_reference.alt_backends: other backends that can run this model
field_reference.requires_comfyui: always false for seeded models (ComfyUI is an optional plug-in only)
field_reference.size_mb_approx: approximate primary-artifact download size in MB
field_reference.quant_variants: notable quantized/size variants and their approx sizes
field_reference.hardware: cpu_capable, gpu_required, min_vram_gb, min_ram_gb, os_arch, speed_note
field_reference.capability_labels: nsfw_capable, license, commercial_use(yes|no|conditional), commercial_use_notes, base_model_lineage, known_risks
field_reference.enabled: whether seeded enabled by default (heavy/optional models may seed disabled)
